title: Works Well!
text: Works Well!. I've always kept the honey in its original container in the cabinet with the spices. No matter how careful we are, it always seems to be sticky on the shelf where we keep it. This honey jar has been wonderful! Because it looks so nice, I have it out on a lazy Susan on the counter. The dipper dispenser does a great job of keeping the honey mess-free. There haven't been any stickiness issues! Plus, it's Rae Dunn! I am a fan of Rae Dunn products, so that makes it even better!

product_metadata.title: Rae Dunn Honey Pot Dispenser Jar with Dipper Stick, Cute Glass Jar with Lid and Beehive Shaped Dipper
features: FARMHOUSE DECOR WITH MODERN STYLE - Clear glass Rae Dunn honey jar with natural wood lid, glass dipper and wooden ball handle grip.
MAKE TEA TIME A LITTLE SWEETER WITH THE HONEY POT AND DIPPER SET. The natural acacia wooden dipper is perfect for drizzling honey on biscuits or adding to tea, without the hassle or mess.
RAE DUNN KITCHEN DECOR WITH HAND LETTERED LOOK - Cute Stem Print style text on clear glass jar with simple - HONEY - caption.
GLASS JAR WITH LID - HONEY STORAGE JAR AND DISPENSER - Honey dripper stick allows you to easily drizzle just the right amount of honey to pastries, beverages, and more.
GREAT GIFT IDEA FOR GIRLFRIEND, WIFE, MOTHER, DAUGHTER - Any Rae Dunn fan will love this classic kitchen essential.
